row.evidence: Lifesize's admin docs describe only SAML 2.0 SSO, where the login service uses the firstname, lastname and email attributes 'to build an account for each user' (JIT); no SCIM endpoint is documented.
row.notes: Lifesize is now an Enghouse Video brand; lifesize.com/pricing redirects to enghousevideo.com/lifesize, which has no public plans (Book a Demo only; the Enghouse buy-now page sells Vidyo, not Lifesize). SSO is SAML 2.0 and must be included in the subscription. User creation is JIT on SAML sign-in; the Okta OIN app is SAML/SWA only (SCIM and provisioning unticked) and Entra's 'automatic user provisioning' note describes JIT after sign-in. Users are otherwise invited or deleted by hand in the admin console. Enghouse marketing mentions APIs to manage users but no public API reference was found.

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint in Lifesize's help centre; provisioning is JIT on SAML sign-in. 'false' here is from absence after searching the support sitemap and site search.

user_api.notes: Enghouse's Lifesize integrations page says Lifesize offers APIs to manage users (c12), but no public API reference was found (developer.lifesize.com does not resolve; api.lifesizecloud.com returns 403), so availability is left null.

okta.notes: OIN page markup ticks only SAML and SWA; SCIM and every Provisioning capability are unticked.

entra.notes: The tutorial's 'automatic user provisioning' is JIT on first SAML sign-in, not Entra SCIM provisioning.

onelogin.notes: Enghouse lists OneLogin among supported SSO providers; OneLogin's own connector page was not checked (blocks bots).

jumpcloud.notes: jumpcloud.com returned 403 to curl; not checked further.

fallbacks.notes: Admins can export the user directory (c13) but no CSV import is documented; users join by admin invite (c7).
